properties.title: Timeline (newest first)
properties.query: SOURCE '/agentledger/gateway-audit' | fields @timestamp, event, tool, decision, reason, status, agent_id, grant_id | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50

properties.title: Denials by reason
properties.query: SOURCE '/agentledger/gateway-audit' | filter event = 'decision' and decision = 'deny' | stats count(*) as n by reason

properties.title: Sentinel locks
properties.query: SOURCE '/agentledger/gateway-audit' | fields @timestamp, grant_id, agent_id, reason | filter event = 'sentinel' | sort @timestamp desc

properties.title: Succeeded changes
properties.query: SOURCE '/agentledger/gateway-audit' | fields @timestamp, tool, artifact.kind, artifact.sha, artifact.number | filter event = 'outcome' and status = 'succeeded' | sort @timestamp asc
